test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

Much ado about nothing

options.text: Great fuss over a trivial matter

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Great fuss over a trivial matter". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Much ado about nothing"** refers to a situation where there is a lot of unnecessary fuss or commotion over something insignificant. (तुच्छ मामले पर बहुत अधिक शोर या हलचल करना) • **Example: **The argument between the two co-workers was much ado about nothing, as it was over a minor misunderstanding. • **"Great fuss over a trivial matter"** means making a big deal out of something that is not important or worth the attention. (छोटे या महत्वहीन मुद्दे पर अत्यधिक ध्यान देना) • **Example: **Her complaint about the color of the curtains seemed like a great fuss over a trivial matter. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Loud action with lasting impact **(तेज कार्रवाई जिसका स्थायी प्रभाव हो): Refers to a significant act or event that has a long-lasting effect. • **Example:** The launch of the new product was a loud action with lasting impact in the tech industry. • **Option 3: Deep emotional reaction **(गहरी भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया): Refers to a strong and profound feeling triggered by a situation or event. • **Example: **She had a deep emotional reaction after hearing the news of her friend's success. • **Option 4: Sudden success **(अचानक सफलता): Refers to achieving something significant in a short period of time. • **Example:** His novel became a sudden success after it received critical acclaim. 34:T67e, The correct answer is** option 1.**
